RemainingQuotas.description: The quotas of an api key: the calls it is allowed to make in the current throttling window, day and month, the calls it made, and the calls it has left. The quotas of an api key without limit are 10000000

authorizedCallsPerWindow.description: The calls the api key is allowed to make during a throttling window (the `throttlingQuota` of the api key, per second for the legacy strategy)

throttlingCallsPerWindow.description: The calls the api key made during the current throttling window

remainingCallsPerWindow.description: The calls the api key can still make during the current throttling window

authorizedCallsPerDay.description: The calls the api key is allowed to make per day (its `dailyQuota`)

currentCallsPerDay.description: The calls the api key made today

remainingCallsPerDay.description: The calls the api key can still make today

authorizedCallsPerMonth.description: The calls the api key is allowed to make per month (its `monthlyQuota`)

currentCallsPerMonth.description: The calls the api key made this month

remainingCallsPerMonth.description: The calls the api key can still make this month

ApiKeyValidationError.description: Why an api key was refused: an error, or the errors of the entity validators of the admin

oneOf.description: The api key was refused by the entity validators of the admin behind the credentials

details.description: What the validators say: a message, or the errors of the validators that refused the api key

oneOf.description: The errors of the validators that refused the api key

items.example: the client name has to start with 'team-'

details: the client name has to start with 'team-'

ApiKeyDeletion.description: The outcome of the deletion of an api key

deleted.description: Always true: the api key is deleted

ApiLiveStats.description: The live statistics of an api: the statistics of each of the routes it exposes, added up. The values are rounded to two decimals. An id that is not the one of an api answers an empty object

calls.description: The calls the routes of the api served since the statistics were last reset

dataIn.description: The bytes the routes of the api received. Always 0: the statistics of the routes are not added up for this field

dataOut.description: The bytes the routes of the api sent. Always 0: the statistics of the routes are not added up for this field

rate.description: The calls per second the routes of the api serve, over the recent calls

duration.description: The sum, over the routes of the api, of the average duration of their recent calls, in milliseconds

overhead.description: The sum, over the routes of the api, of the average time otoroshi added to their recent calls, in milliseconds

ApiFromOpenApiRequest.description: Where an openapi document is, and where the api built from it is exposed. Every field is required

domain.description: The domain the api is exposed on

openapi.description: The url of the openapi (or swagger) document, fetched by otoroshi. A yaml document has to be served with an `application/yaml` or `text/yaml` content type, anything else is read as json

contextPath.description: The path the routes of the api are exposed under

backendHostname.description: The hostname of the targets of the backend of the api, one target per server of the document

backendPath.description: The root path of the backend of the api

_loc.description: The location of the api to build, which the admin behind the credentials has to be able to write. The default tenant (organization) and team when absent. The api built is in the default location anyway

ApiDeployTransitionError.description: The deployment would move the api to a state it cannot reach from its own: a `removed` api refuses the deployment of a draft in `staging`, which would publish it

error_description.description: A message naming the state of the api and the state the deployment would set

from.description: The state the api is in, `removed` being the only one a deployment can fail from

to.description: The state the deployment would have set, `published` for a draft in `staging`

ApiDuplicationRequest.description: What changes in the copy of an api. The other fields of the body are ignored

contextPath.description: The context path of the copy. `/vnew` when absent

version.description: The version of the copy. `vnew` when absent

ApiDuplicationResult.description: The outcome of the duplication of an api: the id of the copy, saved in the `staging` state

id.description: The id generated for the copy (`api_<uuid>`), to read it with `GET /apis/apis.otoroshi.io/v1/apis/{id}`
